title: Good: Comprehensive DoS protection constants and SECURITY comments
description: The code has well-documented security constants (MAX_PEERS=64, MAX_CANDIDATES=32, MAX_RECEIVED_ROUTE_PEERS=64, DAO_TIMESTAMP_FRESHNESS_SECONDS=300) with SECURITY: comments explaining the rationale. The receive_from_peer function validates RPL instance ID, rejects self-origin, checks timestamp freshness, and validates OSCORE sender. This is defensive design worth preserving.
